results.assistantMessageContent: 这是原生流验收替身。权限与预算由真实宿主校验。此响应不代表真实模型能力。

findings: GaNativeModelBroker performs authorization, budget reservation and ledger commit for real; only the native model stream output is replaced by the explicit test-only fixture
The generic FakeModelInferenceGateway does not cover the native GA stream; the fixture is the only override
Authority/budget/ledger remain real: reservation precedes the stream and ledger commits before executable calls are released
limitations: Native model output is a deterministic test-only fixture; this is NOT real-provider qualification and NOT production fallback
No in-flight cross-instance SSE live poller, in-flight revocation, slow client, kill-process takeover, DB outage or fleet key rotation/rollback acceptance in this scenario
Two workers are acceptance settings (15s lease, 200ms poll); no peak-capacity claim

addendum.note: After this scenario, a further in-flight run (1e53f260-3ecd-428a-b744-2ba8ea2e4c80) with a 6s fixture delay exceeded the 15s task lease and left one more MODEL/UNKNOWN ledger row (call_sequence 300). The ledger UNKNOWN count in this file (4) is therefore a snapshot of the successful scenario only; the live count is now 5. See P2_LEASE_EXPIRY_HONEST_FAILURE.json.
